notes: New: Model Swaps. Play as another character: a new tab where you pick a character and press Apply. Only how your own Slayer looks on your screen changes; your armour stays equipped and nothing about gameplay, other players or behemoths is touched. Characters can be downloaded in the tab, copied in, or converted from a glTF model file. "Use my own Slayer" puts everything back. Close the game once after updating so the new game mod is installed.
